method: Atlas AI under each manager arm, every other firm unchanged (rule firms on their rule). Same seed and window: same orders, so arms are paired. Per run: P&L against holding the starting inventory at the last mid (dividends count), fills, edge, largest fall of that P&L (hourly samples), win rate = fills / auctions bid in. Per window: mean over seeds. Mean over windows with a percentile bootstrap 90% interval (2000 resamples of windows, seed 1). pnlVsFixed: the paired difference with the fixed arm. The llm arm pays no inference here (500 USDC base units a decision in the swarm).
